retail_vs_institutional_reaction.retail_sentiment_summary: Retail enthusiasm on r/wallstreetbets, Threads, and X is overwhelmingly bullish following the headline GAAP EPS beat ($6.18 vs $5.64 expected) and the post-market rally pushing Meta stock past $712. Retail traders celebrated Mark Zuckerberg's aggressive framing of 'Personal Superintelligence' and the debut of Muse and Muse Wonder frontier AI models, alongside continued momentum in Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.institutional_sentiment_summary: Institutional portfolio managers and equity research desks express measured optimism. The core advertising engine displayed phenomenal health, with price per ad expanding +11% YoY driven by AI-powered Advantage+ ad targeting. The Q4 revenue guidance midpoint ($66.5B) matched consensus expectations. However, hedge fund analysts noted that Q3 CapEx reached an astonishing $30.12B, resulting in negative True Free Cash Flow (-$6.87B) once $7.66B in stock-based compensation is accounted for, underscoring Meta's massive infrastructure bet heading into 2027.
retail_vs_institutional_reaction.after_hours_movement_driver: The stock gained +2.12% to $712.31 (up +$14.79 from $697.52 regular close) as investors rewarded the clean GAAP EPS beat ($6.18 vs $5.64), strong ad pricing realization (+11%), and in-line Q4 guidance, despite warnings of significant CapEx expansion in 2027.
